Delete your account and history.

You can request deletion through the web game without reinstalling the mobile app.

  1. Open Account using the button below.
  2. Sign in to the email account you want to delete. Use a fresh code if asked.
  3. Choose Delete my account, read the confirmation, and type DELETE.
Open account deletion

What is deleted

The live authentication account, email identity, private completion history, attempt records, player progress, and time bank (including unused purchased time) are removed. The account’s device save, current field and pending assistance, purchase, ad and recovery records are removed in the browser/app where you perform deletion. A storage or connection failure can require a startup retry; keep the app installed until cleanup is confirmed. Guest saves and other accounts are preserved. Other devices may retain a local copy until their app data is cleared; the deleted account can no longer retrieve cloud history.

What remains

Minimal provider transaction identifiers, product, quantity, provider-reported monetary observations/country and financial status remain to prevent duplicate credit and handle refunds, with their game-account reference removed. These transaction tombstones do not currently have an automatic expiry. Registered purchase profiles are queued for provider cleanup, which is verified separately from deleting your game account. Email delivery/security logs require a separate retention review. A pseudonymous retired-account hash, minimal cleanup audit and random deletion receipt remain for recovery and duplicate prevention, with no automatic expiry currently configured; these records are not anonymous. Contact support for cleanup status and retention details. Shared stage definitions are not personal data and remain available to other players. If provider backups exist, their copies expire on the configured backup schedule. Separate guest saves on other devices are not linked to the account.

Guest play

If you never signed in, there is no cloud account to delete. Clear this site's browser storage or the app's data to remove the local guest save.

Need help?

Contact support. Never post sign-in codes, passwords, or private account details in public issues. The publisher will provide a private support email before enabling production accounts.
